concept: Full-body concept art of Goro, the giant four-armed half-dragon warrior from Mortal Kombat, for a video game, seen strictly from the front: he faces the camera straight on, in a symmetrical standing pose. He is a towering muscular humanoid with tan reptilian skin, a bald head with a scowling face, a black loincloth and gold armbands. He has four powerful arms: two upper arms coming from his shoulders and two lower arms coming from just below them. Rig-ready pose: all four arms are held out away from his body and away from each other, like a wide A-pose, with a clear gap between every arm and between the arms and the torso, fists closed, and he stands on his two thick legs, slightly apart, with a visible gap between them. One single creature, centered, the whole body visible from head to feet. Plain uniform light grey studio background, no floor, no ground, no pedestal, no cast shadow, soft even studio lighting.
